profile_text.body:
Chegg is a for-profit, publicly traded education technology company founded in 2005 and headquartered in Santa Clara, California (ticker: CHGG, CIK 0001364954). The company describes itself as offering innovative learning tools with 24/7 homework help across more than 50 subjects, combining step-by-step support, real experts, and student feedback to help users work through difficult academic material. Its services are available through Chegg Study and Chegg Study Pack subscriptions, and a 2024 survey the company fielded among a sample of U.S. customers (n=712) is cited on its site in connection with user experience claims.

Chegg's tracked AI product is CheggMate, categorized as an Education and Research AI tool functioning as a study assistant for academic help. The product is noted in connection with considerations around student data, content accuracy, and honor code implications, reflecting the range of issues that accompany AI-assisted academic support tools.
